title: A poem with a plan
description:
Print this short poem exactly, one `std::cout` statement per line:

```
Roses are red,
Violets are blue,
Semicolons end statements,
And braces come in two.
```

Above each statement, write a short comment saying what that line of the poem is about. Comments do not change the output; they are practice for explaining code to the next reader (who is usually you, a month later).
hints: Watch the commas at the ends of the first three lines and the full stop at the end of the last one.
